KIMI K3.1 PRO STARTER KIT — YOUR TEN-MINUTE CONTENT PROJECT
The AGI Edge / The AGI Guide

FINISH LINE
One approved 30-second Reel script, six practical shots, and one caption.
Ten minutes is a suggested drafting budget; filming, editing, and response
latency are separate.

QUICK START
Open Kimi with the campaign link below. Follow any account prompts shown.
Kimi confirms K3.1 Pro web/mobile availability. Use it where your account
offers it. Start a new chat, then run the three prompts in order.
This guide is free and makes no promise of free K3.1 Pro access or a trial.

http://kimi.ai?utm_campaign=TR_YqObYt0Y&utm_content=&utm_medium=Instagram&utm_source=CH_pzQ7f4g6&utm_term=

MINUTES 0–2 / WRITE YOUR BRIEF
Rough idea: ____________________
Audience: ____________________
Viewer's next step: ____________________
Tone: ____________________
Verified facts to include (or none): ____________________
Location and available props: ____________________
Required sponsorship disclosure (if applicable): ____________________

MINUTES 2–5 / SCRIPT
Run prompt 01 from prompts.txt. Read it aloud.
Does the hook name a specific useful idea?
Does it sound like you? Does it fit 30 seconds when spoken naturally?
Check factual claims and edit before approving.
Approved script: ____________________

MINUTES 5–8 / SHOT LIST
In the same chat, run prompt 02 using the approved script.
Check that six shots cover every spoken line, total 30 seconds without
any gaps or overlaps, and can be filmed with your listed setup.
Shot list saved: ____________________

MINUTES 8–10 / CAPTION
Run prompt 03 with the approved script and your intended next step.
Check the opening line, factual claims, and any required disclosure.
Make the call to action one you can actually fulfill.
Caption saved: ____________________

BEFORE FILMING
[ ] Script read aloud and timed.
[ ] Every claim checked or removed.
[ ] All six shots achievable with available location and props.
[ ] Caption matches the content and next step.
[ ] Required disclosure included where applicable.
